_doc: MoT real-pool (MONET-real + GPIC) sampling-weight config v1. Pairs with doc/mot/采样权重spec_v1_20260616.md. Caption=pointer, weights NOT baked into manifest; the loader implements band-first sampling + these factors. anime/TextAtlas domain entries are placeholders until their manifests exist.
_source_alpha_note: source_factor(i) ∝ N_source(i)^(-alpha). CONFIRMED 0.5 (Evan 2026-06-16). dry-run stage256 of-total: laion+coyo 46.6%, da4k 0.7%, eff_clusters 14481. alpha=1 is PATHOLOGICAL: da4k micro-source (11,688 imgs) blows up to 14%; cap range [0.3,0.7] if revisited.
_aes_note: Evan: no aes reweighting (bottom already cut at selection).
_monet_real_gpic_ratio_complete_v1_note: This 80:20 is the 母池(60M)/daily config. The ACTIVE complete_v1 line (daily+anime) uses 11:7 at 256 (daily static pool 11M:7M; Evan 2026-06-17, replaces 80:20) -- see configs/t5_sampling_complete_v1.json.
_gpic_512_note: GPIC off at 512/1024 by default (v3 doc: GPIC 退场, 256 asset). Its ge512&high-aes eligibility is still computed, so a small 512 transition/ablation subset can be enabled, e.g. 512 -> [0.97, 0.03].

resolution_routing._note: Eligibility masks only. GPIC@512 eligibility is computed but DISABLED by default via monet_real_gpic_ratio.512=[1,0]; do NOT sample GPIC@512 unless that ratio is changed.

_aes_gpic512_note: GPIC must clear this aes percentile (laion_improved, ~5.57 at p75) to enter the 512 transition subset. Tunable.

band_to_captioner_priority._note: MONET: pick first captioner whose tok_* falls in the drawn band. Priority is a SOFT preference: if none of the listed captioners lands in the band, FALL BACK to any captioner with tok_* in the band (has_tX guarantees one exists). GPIC always uses its single i1 caption; synthetic uses its generation prompt.

loader_rules._note: Boundary rules settled after 2 independent audits (Evan 2026-06-16). Applied at load time; manifests NOT rebuilt. All counts verified on the published parquet (job evan-mot-t5-verify-audit2).
loader_rules.holdout_policy: global_exclude: loader MUST filter holdout==1 in EVERY pool. rich_v1 already 0 (excluded at selection); synthetic_v1 (shipped pre-decision) still carries 6565 holdout rows -> filter at load. Builder script now adds & holdout==0 so future rebuilds are clean.
loader_rules.band_eligibility: A row is eligible for band b ONLY if some captioner has tok IN band b AND tok>0. Do NOT trust has_tX/cap_* alone: verified 13 MONET rows have has_t4==1 but NO positive T4 token (gemini overflowed) -> they must be excluded from T4.
loader_rules.tok_le_0_unavailable: Treat tok_*<=0 as that captioner unavailable. Shipped rich_v1 is legacy int16 with 18 negatives (17 tok_gemini + 1 tok_original); 13 of them are a row's only T4 captioner -> those rows have no usable T4. Scripts now int32+clip so future rebuilds have none.
loader_rules.band_captioner_fallback: priority is soft; if no priority captioner is in-band, fall back to any captioner with tok>0 in band (see band_to_captioner_priority.fallback).
loader_rules.gpic_512_1024_zero: GPIC weight = 0 at 512 and 1024 (monet_real_gpic_ratio.512/1024 = [1,0]). Authoritative; do NOT enable GPIC@512 from resolution_routing eligibility alone.
loader_rules.aes_missing_null_or_nan: Treat aes null OR NaN as missing (5,468 in MONET real). Not used here (aes weighting off); if used elsewhere, median-fill or exclude.
loader_rules.global_stats: Compute N_source and cluster_size ONCE over the full 60M real pool; never recompute per-shard / per-band / per-stage subset.
loader_rules.domain_mix_normalize: domain_mix is an approximate placeholder (256 sums to 0.98; anime/TextAtlas pending) -> loader MUST renormalize before use.
loader_rules.image_source_tar_not_thumbnail: VERIFIED. Images = full-res JPEG from the .tar webdataset config, NOT the parquet 'thumbnail' (<=384px preview, would ruin 512/1024 stages). MONET/synth: src_shard .parquet->.tar, member {src_key}.jpg. GPIC: {src_root}/images/train/{src_shard}/{src_key}.{ext} -- ext is MIXED (~88% .jpg + ~12% .png), do NOT hardcode .jpg; authoritative path is the s3key column in parquets/gpic_train_{src_shard}.parquet (read alongside the GPIC caption). Confirmed .tar image size == manifest width/height; da4k/synthetic have no url but full-res IS in .tar.

domain_mix._note: Upper-layer cross-domain mixer. real slots (monet_real/gpic) use this spec; anime/textatlas are PLACEHOLDERS (manifests not ready); synthetic uses synthetic_v1. NOTE: rows are approximate and may not sum to 1 (256 = 0.98) -> loader MUST renormalize.

knob_status.monet_real_gpic_ratio: 256=80:20 fixed (v3); 512/1024 GPIC=0 (Evan confirmed 2026-06-16, GPIC off at 512)
knob_status.aes_gpic512_percentile: default p75 (only used if GPIC@512 re-enabled)
